questions.question: A shopkeeper lists the price of a fan at 34% above its cost price and offers a 25% discount on its list price. If he earns a profit of ₹177, then what is the list price (in ₹) of the fan?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = 34% above cost price

Discount = 25% on marked price

Profit = ₹177

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price = CP × (1 + 34/100)

Selling Price = MP × (1 − 25/100)

Profit = SP − CP

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let cost price = CP

⇒ Marked price = 1.34 × CP

⇒ Selling price = (1.34CP) × 0.75

⇒ Selling price = 1.005CP

⇒ Profit = Selling price − Cost price

⇒ 1.005CP − CP = 177

⇒ 0.005CP = 177

⇒ CP = 177 ÷ 0.005

⇒ CP = 35400

⇒ Marked price = 1.34 × 35400

⇒ Marked price = 47436

**∴ The correct list price is ₹47,436.**

questions.question: Find the HCF of 120, 144 and 168.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

120

144

168

**Formula Used:**

HCF is the greatest number that divides all given numbers exactly.

Use prime factorization of each number.

**Calculation:**

Prime factorization of 120: ⇒ 120 = 2³ × 3 × 5

Prime factorization of 144: ⇒ 144 = 2⁴ × 3²

Prime factorization of 168: ⇒ 168 = 2³ × 3 × 7

Common prime factors: ⇒ 2 and 3

Take the lowest power of common factors: ⇒ 2³ and 3

HCF = 2³ × 3

⇒ HCF = 8 × 3

⇒ HCF = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**

questions.question: Eight times the present age of P exceeds the present age of Q by 46 years. After 10 years, three times Q’s age will be 12 years less than eight times P’s age at that time. What is the present age (in years) of Q?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Eight times P’s age exceeds Q’s age by 46 years.

After 10 years, three times Q’s age will be 12 years less than eight times P’s age.

**Formula Used:**

Future age = Present age + years

Linear equations solved by substitution

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let present ages be P and Q.

⇒ 8P − Q = 46 …(1)

⇒ After 10 years: 3(Q + 10) = 8(P + 10) − 12 …(2)

⇒ Expand equation (2):

⇒ 3Q + 30 = 8P + 80 − 12

⇒ 3Q = 8P + 38 …(3)

⇒ From (1): Q = 8P − 46

⇒ Substitute into (3):

⇒ 3(8P − 46) = 8P + 38

⇒ 24P − 138 = 8P + 38

⇒ 24P − 8P = 176

⇒ 16P = 176

⇒ P = 11

⇒ Q = 8P − 46

⇒ Q = 88 − 46

⇒ Q = 42

**∴ The present age of Q is 42 years.**

questions.question: A man goes to Indore from Bhopal at a speed of 20 km/hr and returns to Bhopal at speed of 30 km/hr, through the same route. What is his average speed (in km/hr) of the entire journey?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed from Bhopal to Indore = 20 km/hr

Speed from Indore to Bhopal = 30 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = (2 × Speed₁ × Speed₂) / (Speed₁ + Speed₂)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 20 × 30) / (20 + 30)

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 600) / 50

⇒ Average Speed = 1200 / 50

⇒ Average Speed = 24 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 24 km/hr.**

questions.question: A sum of money triples itself at a certain rate of compound interest in 15 years. In how many years will it amount to 81 times of itself?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A sum of money triples itself at a certain rate of compound interest, compounded annually in 15 years.

Find in how many years it will amount to 81 times of itself.

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + r)t

Where,

A = Final Amount

P = Principal

r = Compound Interest Rate

t = Time

**Calculation:**

Given, the money triples in 15 years:

⇒ 3P = P(1 + r)¹⁵

⇒ 3 = (1 + r)¹⁵

Now, to find the time for the money to become 81 times itself:

⇒ 81P = P(1 + r)t

⇒ 81 = (1 + r)t

Using the relation (1 + r)¹⁵ = 3:

⇒ 81 = 3t/¹⁵

⇒ 81 = 3⁴

⇒ t/15 = 4

⇒ t = 4 × 15

⇒ t = 60 years

**∴ The correct answer is 60 years.**

questions.question: The area of one side of a rectangular box is 45 cm² , and the area of another adjacent side is 24 cm2 . If the area of the top surface (third side) is 30 cm², find the volume of the box.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of one side = 45 cm²

Area of adjacent side = 24 cm²

Area of top surface = 30 cm²

**Formula Used:**

If sides of a rectangular box are a, b, c then:

ab = 45, bc = 24, ac = 30

Volume = abc = √[(ab)(bc)(ac)]

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume = √(45 × 24 × 30)

⇒ 45 × 24 = 1080

⇒ 1080 × 30 = 32400

⇒ Volume = √32400

⇒ Volume = 180

**∴ The volume of the box is 180 cm³.**

questions.question:
What is the median of the following data?

49, 96, 59, 54, 97, 30, 44, 46, 36, 55, 23
questions.solution:
**Given:**

49, 96, 59, 54, 97, 30, 44, 46, 36, 55, 23

**Formula Used:**

Median = Middle value when numbers are arranged in ascending order

**Calculation:**

⇒ Arrange the data in ascending order: 23, 30, 36, 44, 46, 49, 54, 55, 59, 96, 97

⇒ Total numbers = 11 (odd count)

⇒ Median = Value at position (n + 1) / 2

⇒ Position = (11 + 1) / 2 = 6

⇒ Median = Value at position 6 = 49

**∴ The correct answer is 49.**

questions.question: Pipe P can fill (2)/(9) part of a tank in 28 hours, and pipe Q can fill (2)/(7) part of the same tank in 12 hours. Both P and Q were kept open for 6 hours, then both were closed. Pipe R alone was then opened and it emptied the water in the tank in 8 hours. Pipes P, Q and R together can fill the empty tank in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pipe P fills (2)/(9) of the tank in 28 hours.

Pipe Q fills (2)/(7) of the tank in 12 hours.

P and Q work together for 6 hours, then are closed.

Pipe R alone empties the water filled by P and Q in 8 hours.

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Work / Time

Full time = Total work / Efficiency

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time taken by P to fill full tank = dfrac{28 times 9}{2} = 126 hours

⇒ Time taken by Q to fill full tank = dfrac{12 times 7}{2} = 42 hours

⇒ Efficiency of P = dfrac{1}{126}

⇒ Efficiency of Q = dfrac{1}{42}

⇒ Work done by P and Q in 6 hours = 6(dfrac{1}{126} + dfrac{1}{42})

⇒ dfrac{1}{42} = dfrac{3}{126}

⇒ Work in 6 hours = 6 times dfrac{4}{126} = dfrac{24}{126} = dfrac{4}{21}

⇒ Pipe R empties (4)/(21) in 8 hours

⇒ Efficiency of R = dfrac{(4)/(21)}{8} = dfrac{1}{42} (negative work)

⇒ R alone empties full tank in 42 hours

⇒ Combined efficiency of P, Q and R = dfrac{1}{126} + dfrac{1}{42} - dfrac{1}{42} = dfrac{1}{126}

⇒ Time taken when all three work together = dfrac{1}{(1)/(126)} = 126 hours

**∴ Pipes P, Q and R together can fill the empty tank in 126 hours.**

questions.question: The HCF and the LCM of two numbers are 29 and 174, respectively. If one of the numbers is 58, find the other one.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

HCF = 29

LCM = 174

One number = 58

**Formula Used:**

HCF × LCM = Product of the numbers

Product of the numbers = First number × Second number

**Calculation:**

⇒ 29 × 174 = 58 × Second number

⇒ 5046 = 58 × Second number

⇒ Second number = 5046 / 58

⇒ Second number = 87

**∴ The correct answer is 87.**

questions.question: ₹32,100 were divided among A, B and C, such that 2 times of A = 7 times of B = 4 times of C. Find the share of A.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total amount = 32,100

2 × A = 7 × B = 4 × C

**Formula Used:**

Convert equal expressions into ratios

Share = (Individual ratio / Total ratio) × Total amount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let 2A = 7B = 4C = k

⇒ A = (k)/(2)

⇒ B = (k)/(7)

⇒ C = (k)/(4)

⇒ Total amount:

⇒ (k)/(2) + (k)/(7) + (k)/(4) = 32100

LCM of 2, 7, 4 = 28

⇒ (14k + 4k + 7k)/(28) = 32100

⇒ (25k)/(28) = 32100

⇒ k = (32100 times 28)/(25)

⇒ k = 35952

⇒ A = (k)/(2) = (35952)/(2) = 17976

**∴ The share of A is ₹17,976.**

questions.question: Sapna invested ₹22,800 on simple interest, partly at 6% per annum and partly at 4% per annum. If she earns equal interests from the two investments after 8 years, then find the sum invested at 6% per annum (in ₹).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total investment = ₹22,800

Interest rate (part 1) = 6% per annum

Interest rate (part 2) = 4% per annum

Time = 8 years

Interest from both investments is equal.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100

Total Investment = Investment at 6% + Investment at 4%

**Calculation:**

Let the investment at 6% per annum be ₹x.

⇒ Investment at 4% per annum = ₹(22,800 - x)

Interest from 6% investment = Interest from 4% investment

⇒ (x × 6 × 8) / 100 = ((22,800 - x) × 4 × 8) / 100

⇒ 48x / 100 = (22,800 × 32 - 32x) / 100

⇒ 48x = 22,800 × 32 - 32x

⇒ 48x + 32x = 22,800 × 32

⇒ 80x = 729,600

⇒ x = 729,600 / 80

⇒ x = ₹9,120

**∴ The correct answer is ₹9,120.**

questions.question: P, Q and R invest sum in the ratio of 2 : 22 : 70, respectively. If they earned a total profit of ₹4,700 at the end of the year, then what is the difference between share of Q and R?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Investment ratio of P : Q : R = 2 : 22 : 70

Total profit = 4700

**Formula Used:**

Share = (Individual ratio / Total ratio) × Total profit

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total ratio = 2 + 22 + 70 = 94

⇒ Value of 1 ratio = 4700 ÷ 94 = 50

⇒ Share of Q = 22 × 50 = 1100

⇒ Share of R = 70 × 50 = 3500

⇒ Difference = 3500 − 1100 = 2400

**∴ The difference between the share of Q and R is ₹2400.**

questions.question: Find the surface area of the cuboid with dimensions 3 cm, 5 cm and 8 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length = 8 cm

Width = 5 cm

Height = 3 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a Cuboid = 2 × (Length × Width + Width × Height + Height × Length)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × (8 × 5 + 5 × 3 + 3 × 8)

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × (40 + 15 + 24)

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × 79

⇒ Surface Area = 158 square cm

**∴ The correct answer is 158 square cm.**

questions.question: The product of two consecutive natural numbers is 90. The greater of the two numbers is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Product of two consecutive natural numbers = 90

**Formula Used:**

If n is the smaller number, consecutive numbers are n and n + 1.

Product = n × (n + 1)

**Calculation:**

⇒ n × (n + 1) = 90

⇒ n² + n = 90

⇒ n² + n - 90 = 0

⇒ (n + 10)(n - 9) = 0

⇒ n = 9 (as n must be a natural number)

⇒ Greater number = n + 1 = 9 + 1 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**
